bead.title: Clean server-test and projection-helper regressions
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The release matrix still exposes server-test and projection-helper regressions that basic CI misses.
ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-server/tests/server.rs:1645-1652` still sits on the old `idempotency_key` callsite shape, and `crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs:3043-3070` is the helper seam that required the missing `emit_change_records` initializer; the same release-gate surface also picks up the six-crate fmt/clippy noise.
PROPOSED FIX: update the server test callsites, keep `emit_change_records` explicit in helper constructors, and clear the release-gate formatting/clippy warnings in the touched crates.
NON-SCOPE: PR gate wiring, release notification plumbing, postgres wrapper ownership, and sqlite historical-read plumbing.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestChangeRecordIdempotencyKeyCallsitesCompile: the server tests compile against the current `idempotency_key` shape and the affected assertions still pass.
2. TestProjectionHelperCarriesEmitChangeRecords: helper constructors set `emit_change_records` explicitly and the projection helper remains green under the release matrix.
3. TestReleaseMatrixStyleClean: `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
4. TestGoTestGate: `go test ./...` passes.
5. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
